notes.title: Hard-mode and minor fixes
notes.content:
[b]Who needs Hard-Mode?[/b] 
With this update you'll be able to choose to play the game as normally or in hard-mode. Hard-mode introduces the following changes to your playthrough:

[list]
[*] The respect system is removed; you'll have to fight every enemy.
[*] Wacky, Dante and Sealenas move sets have been changed to make encounters more challangeing.
[*] Some items have been removed or are relocated.
[/list]

[b]Minor fixes[/b]
This update also fixes some small bugs and problems. The major fixes are as following:
[list]
[*] The "holy sword" attack requires you to equip a sword.
[*] Animations that didn't work correctly for the female character are fixed.
[*] The immortal state has been balanced.
[/list]

[b]Closing remarks[/b] 
I hope you'll appreciate the new Hard-Mode and that it gives you the motivation to pick up GraveBond and play again, or for your first time. 

All the best and happy Easter! 

//Måns

notes.title: The U.F.O Ending
notes.content:
[b]The U.F.O Ending is finally here![/b]
Finally the U.F.O. Ending is released and I hope you'll pick up your controller or keyboard or whatever you're using to play GraveBond again.

[b]What is the U.F.O. ending about?[/b]
Venture back into Necros and hunt down strange Alien relics and other traces of the extraterrestrial presence that may reside in the underworld. The U.F.O ending is a new adventure that slowly branches of from the main game. In this adventure you'll have:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704691/f682f87ea57025bf9c2086799cc3f4dc49e033c9.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Two new minigames to play
[*] A new playable character to unlock and play
[*] A new section of Necros to explore
[*] New enemies to fight
[*] New secrets to learn
[*] Two new Bosses to fight
[/list]

[b]Closing remarks[/b]
The U.F.O ending is designed to be much more challenging than anything else in the game, so are you up to the challenge or will you cover in fear?

I hope you'll try it out and have fun in the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704691/2d07fcb1b2cf74b19db6b0dfe65df55cd352d602.png[/img]
//Måns Dalenbring

notes.title: GraveBond 3.0
notes.content:
The "major graphics and other quality fixes" update is finally here. This update includes, as mentioned in the previous post:

[list]
[*] All enemy sprites, in battle, are updated.
[*] Some of the face portraits are updated
[*] Some of the character spirites are updated
[*] Some of the battle sprites are updated
[*] Sound effects are added to the player's footsteps
[*] Player and party have new running animations
[*] Control configurations are added to make the game more accessible
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704691/cfb5ba4370aacc984f6c18083ee726b6441dcf0b.png[/img]
But this update also comes with some changes that were not planned or mentioned in the previous post:

[list]
[*] Experience costs have been added to the respect system, to make it less unbalanced
[*] The player can now choose beetween playing as a boy or a girl
[*] Some of the dialogue has been changed
[*] Dante and Sealena have been given more backstory
[*] More sound effects have been added to the game
[*] Some new characters have been added to the game
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704691/9312d386fc988e6707ef33be055fb67b8c836d78.png[/img]
There may be some further updates down the line, but they will be small.

Development for the "UFO. ending" update have also been proceeding and it is still estimated to be released on October 30th 2025.

notes.title: Updating graphics and other quality fixes.
notes.content:
I'm currently working on updating and polishing details in the game that really needed to. This includes:
[list]
[*]Updates all enemy sprites in battle
[*] Updates some of the face portraits
[*] Updates some of the character sprites
[*] Updates some of the battler sprites
[*] Adds footsteps sound to player
[*] Adds running animations to player characters
[*] Adds control settings
[/list]

There may also be some other fixes and updates, besides this update, I'm also working on another update that includes more story, a different world, and a new ending, but that's further down the road.

The "major graphics and other quality fixes" update will be released on May 30th 2024.

The "UFO. ending" update will be released on October 30th 2025.

notes.title: Clean up Patch
notes.content:
In this patch, the following important things have happened:
-"Bark of doom" is now just called "bark".
- The (ugly) confuse state animation has been reworked.
-Conspiracy bird has received a face portrait in dialogue.
- A little more work has been done before a major update to the game.

Thanks also to everyone who bought the game! Feel free to write a review when you've completed the game! :D

//Måns

notes.content:
The cup minigame in the gambler's house has been fixed. Other than that, there have been some minor language, bug, and voice clip fixes. :)

notes.title: Balancing and minor quality fix patch
notes.content:
With this patch, both the later bosses and secret bosses become more difficult by being able to attack more often. This patch also includes some general grammar and event fixes. A brand new NPC has also been added. 

//Måns
